units.text: The candidate material (roles, projects, education, bullets, tool lists) and the job posting were not included in this conversation, so there is no prior packet to resend and no evidence base to write from.
Every line of a resume produced here would have to be invented, which is the one thing this process forbids.
The candidate's name, location, email and LinkedIn
Each role: exact company name, title, start and end dates, bullets, and the tools attached to that role
Each project: exact project name, bullets, and its attached tools

The job posting and its extracted requirements With those in hand I will return resume_md, cover_letter_md and short_answers_md as a single JSON object, using only the supplied claims, numbers and tool-to-role attachments.
